text: じゃ　ポケモン　つれて　いきなよ

structure.jp: ポケモン　つれて　いきなよ

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: The て-form plus いく means doing something and going away with it. つれて　いきな = 'take it along with you'.

patterns.name: 〜なさい
patterns.explanation: な on a verb stem is a short, casual なさい, a friendly order. いきな = 'go on'.
